title: Same Formulas, Different Semantics: Do Language Models Follow Modal Logic Specifications?

extra.description: Reasoning about necessity and possibility depends on assumptions about accessibility between worlds and about which objects exist at each one. The same inference may therefore hold under one modal system and fail under another. Evaluating language models on such problems requires testing whether their judgments follow the stated semantics rather than a familiar logic.
